channel.title: Bouclier.ai Updates
channel.description: Updates for Bouclier.ai — prompt injection firewall for macOS

item.title: Version 0.2.10
item.description:
Bouclier.ai v0.2.10

Fixed

  • ML classifier (Meta Prompt Guard 2) still wasn't actually loading in v0.2.9. CoreML refuses raw `.mlpackage` files at runtime ("Compile the model with Xcode or MLModel.compileModel(at:)") and SwiftPM doesn't auto-compile. Release builds now pre-compile to `.mlmodelc` via `xcrun coremlcompiler`; dev builds fall back to an on-demand compile cached in Application Support. Fused detection (regex + ML + entropy) is live for real this time.

Changed

  • ML-error badge in the menu bar is now click-to-copy — clicking copies the raw CoreML / tokenizer error string to the clipboard so it can be pasted into bug reports without screenshotting a tooltip.
